## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title is a Conventional Commit (`<type>(<scope>): <description>`).
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] An ADR is added to `docs/decisions/` (or a new ADR supersedes an old one) if this changes a
      decision.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for any change in behaviour.
- [ ] User-facing text follows the wording rule in `CONTRIBUTING.md`: "what the browser exposes",
      "illustrative speech, approximate", and no conformance claims.
